package.name: jedy_vision
package.description:
People in the head camera for the Jedy exercises: person detection (Ultralytics YOLO) and body pose (MediaPipe Pose Landmarker), and demos that use them through jedy_skrobot's robot interface (follow a person, look at a person, copy a person's arms). Also the recognition nodes that jedy_skrobot's ri.what_do_you_see() / ri.gesture() call: objects named by words (YOLOE) and hand gestures (MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer).
A separate package from jedy_skrobot on purpose: its venv carries torch (CPU build) and is about 1.7 GB, which students who do not do the vision exercises should not have to download.
